verdict.rationale: Fin's docs say it is grounded in your knowledge base and applies your specific policies (Voice). Separate pages cover giving Fin guidance, escalation rules and pre-launch scenario testing, and Fin claims tools to deploy AI 'within your own boundaries.' None of this explicitly says Fin declines off-knowledge questions or is blocked from inventing prices or promises; the guidance and escalation items are page titles only. Missing for 10: an explicit documented behaviour for declining questions outside its knowledge, specific guardrails against fabricated policies, prices or commitments, in-depth guardrail configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of hallucination resistance.
